zh: 现在别打扰她，她正处在特别专注、状态极佳的时候。
en: Don't disturb her right now, she's really in the {zone}.

zh: 我一戴上耳机就能进入高度专注的状态，几个小时一晃就过去了。
en: Once I put my headphones on, I get in the {zone} and the hours fly by.

zh: 我们周一简单联系一下，看看测试进展如何。
en: Let's {touch base|catch up|check in} on Monday to see how the testing is going.

zh: 我只是想在见客户之前先跟你通个气。
en: I just wanted to touch {base} with you before the client meeting.

zh: 我们简单通个电话，确保大家的理解是一致的。
en: Let's have a quick call to make sure we're all on the same {page}.

zh: 我觉得我们对“完成”的理解并不一致。
en: I don't think we're on the {same page} about what counts as finished.

zh: 谢谢你提前提醒我修路的事，我会走另一条路。
en: Thanks for the heads {up} about the roadworks, I'll take another route.

zh: 提前跟大家说一声：明天早上办公室的无线网会断一个小时。
en: Just a {heads up|heads-up}: the office wifi will be down for an hour tomorrow morning.

zh: 我们从八点一直干到现在。今天就到此为止吧。
en: We've been at it since eight. Let's call it a {day}.

zh: 天快黑了，所以我们决定今天先收工，明天再接着刷栅栏。
en: It was getting dark, so we decided to {call it a day} and finish painting the fence tomorrow.

zh: 你能让新来的同事尽快了解这个项目的最新情况吗？
en: Can you bring the new guy up to {speed} on the project?

zh: 我花了两三个星期才熟悉并跟上新系统。
en: It took me a couple of weeks to get {up to speed} with the new system.

zh: 日程有任何变动，请随时让我知道。
en: Please keep me in the {loop} about any changes to the schedule.

zh: “周五我去不了，我得接孩子。”“可以理解，没问题。”
en: "I can't come on Friday, I've got to pick up the kids." "Fair {enough}."

zh: 我不需要精确的报价，给个大概的数字就行。
en: I don't need an exact quote, just a {ballpark|rough} figure.

zh: 修屋顶大概要多少钱，你能给我个粗略的估计吗？
en: Can you give me a ballpark {figure|number|estimate} for fixing the roof?

zh: 客户否定了设计方案，所以我们又得从头再来。
en: The client rejected the design, so we're back to square {one}.

zh: 我好多年没有他的消息了，结果他突然毫无预兆地给我打了电话。
en: I hadn't heard from him in years, then he rang me out of the {blue}.

zh: 希望不大，但我还是申请了那个经理职位。
en: It's a long {shot}, but I've applied for the manager role anyway.

zh: 我知道可能性很小，不过今晚的票你们还有剩的吗？
en: I know it's a {long shot}, but do you have any tickets left for tonight?

zh: 她本来就熟悉这套系统，所以第一天上班就马上进入了状态。
en: She already knew the system, so she hit the ground {running} on her first day.

zh: 免费停车，走路五分钟到公司？这根本不用考虑。
en: Free parking and a five-minute walk to work? It's a no-{brainer}.

zh: 这个项目进展顺利，有望在三月底前完成。
en: The project is on {track|course} to finish by the end of March.

zh: 上周我状态不好，不过现在我的健身计划又回到正轨了。
en: I had a bad week, but I'm back on {track} with my gym routine now.

zh: 我今天有点不舒服，所以在家办公。
en: I'm feeling a bit under the {weather} today, so I'll work from home.

zh: 他感冒了，这一整个星期身体都不太舒服。
en: He's been {under the weather|unwell} all week with a cold.

zh: 这是个重大决定。你不如回去考虑一晚上，明天再告诉我？
en: It's a big decision. Why don't you {sleep} on it and tell me tomorrow?

zh: 我对那辆车拿不定主意，所以我跟销售说我要回去考虑一晚。
en: I wasn't sure about the car, so I told the dealer I'd {sleep on it|think about it}.

zh: 周日我们什么都没订。到时候看情况再说吧。
en: We haven't booked anything for Sunday. Let's just play it by {ear}.

zh: 天气可能会变，所以我们到时候见机行事，早上再决定。
en: The weather might change, so we'll {play it by ear} and decide in the morning.

zh: 我从来没冲过浪，不过我愿意试一试。
en: I've never tried surfing, but I'll give it a {go|try|shot|crack}.

zh: 划皮划艇你不试一下，就不会知道自己喜不喜欢。
en: You won't know if you like kayaking until you {give it a go|give it a try|give it a shot|try it}.

zh: 我们周六去徒步。你想一起去吗？
en: We're going for a hike on Saturday. Are you {keen|interested|in}?

zh: 我很想多学一些云安全方面的知识。
en: I'm {keen|eager} to learn more about cloud security.

zh: “我七点来接你。”“好嘞，没问题，到时候见。”
en: "I'll pick you up at seven." "Sweet {as}, see you then."

zh: “我下周再还你钱可以吗？”“行，完全没问题。”
en: "Is it okay if I pay you back next week?" "Yeah, {sweet as|no worries|all good}."

zh: 把钱包收起来，今天这顿我请。
en: Put your wallet away, it's my {shout|treat|turn} today.

zh: 你帮我搬了家，所以晚饭我请你。
en: You helped me move house, so I'll {shout|buy} you dinner.

zh: 抱歉一直没回复，我这一周忙得不可开交。
en: Sorry I haven't replied, I've been flat {out} all week.

zh: 周六晚上后厨忙得团团转，所以上菜特别慢。
en: The kitchen was {flat out|swamped|slammed} on Saturday night, so the food took ages.

zh: 你跑完了全程马拉松？真棒，好样的！
en: You ran the whole marathon? Good {on|for} you!

zh: “我终于考过驾照了。”“干得好啊，哥们！”
en: "I finally passed my driving test." "{Good on you|Good for you|Well done|Congrats}, mate!"

zh: 别担心考试，会非常简单的。
en: Don't worry about the test, it'll be a piece of {cake}.

zh: 圣诞节回国的机票贵得离谱。
en: Flights home at Christmas cost an arm and a {leg}.

zh: 我去买杯咖啡，你能帮我照看一下电脑吗？
en: Could you keep an {eye} on my laptop while I grab a coffee?

zh: 我明天面试。希望一切顺利！
en: I've got my interview tomorrow. Fingers {crossed}!

zh: 今天太感谢你的帮忙了。
en: Thanks {heaps|a lot|so much|loads} for your help today.

zh: 你觉得呢？我们是点披萨还是自己做饭？
en: What do you {reckon|think}? Should we order pizza or cook?

zh: 我们赢了决赛，我高兴极了。
en: I'm {stoked|thrilled|rapt} that we won the final.

zh: 他支持的球队在最后一分钟输了，他难过极了。
en: He was {gutted|devastated} when his team lost in the last minute.

zh: 骑了那么久的车，我累瘫了。
en: I'm {knackered|shattered|exhausted} after that bike ride.

zh: 别点那个链接，看起来有点可疑、不靠谱。
en: Don't click that link, it looks a bit {dodgy|suspicious|sketchy|suss}.

zh: 你今天下午有空简单碰个头吗？
en: Are you free this {arvo|afternoon} for a quick catch-up?

zh: 这是百家饭聚餐，所以每个人都要带一道菜来分享。
en: It's a potluck dinner, so everyone needs to bring a {plate|dish}.

zh: 车上那道划痕别太担心。没事的，会好的。
en: Don't stress about the scratch on the car. She'll be {right|fine}.

zh: 他的名字听起来有点耳熟，但我想不起来我们在哪儿见过。
en: His name rings a {bell}, but I can't remember where we met.

zh: 具体价格我一下子说不上来，不过我可以查一下。
en: I don't know the exact price off the top of my {head}, but I can look it up.

zh: 旧代码太乱了，所以我们从零开始重写了一遍。
en: The old code was such a mess that we rewrote it from {scratch}.

zh: 靠左开车一开始会觉得别扭，但你很快就会掌握窍门的。
en: Driving on the left feels strange at first, but you'll soon get the {hang} of it.

zh: 要不要买电动车，我还在犹豫，拿不定主意。
en: I'm still on the {fence} about buying an electric car.
